{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Feral''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] under the command of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lev Kepzen]]. It helped [[Capture of the Solar Terrors|capture]] the [[Solar Terrors]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] band.
